evals.prompt: Audit this React financial settlement telemetry table for desktop analysts. CSS loads Inter from https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;600&display=swap. Numeric columns (USD amounts, 24h deltas, P99 latencies) use text-align: left without font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Settlement and account codes like O01lI-9B0l render in default Inter with no ss02/cv05/cv08/zero OpenType features. The view uses 8 ad-hoc raw pixel font sizes (11.5px, 12.5px, 13px, 14px, 15px, 17px, 19px, 22px) across 2 weights (400/600) with zero headings >= 24px and no prose blocks; spacing is strictly on 4px multiples (8px, 12px, 16px) with line-height: 1.30, zero !important, min-height cells without overflow: hidden, uniform 16px icons, and 17.81:1 text contrast (#F3F5F8 on #0B0D10).
assertions: Classifies the task as in_universe under analytics_dense_telemetry and triggers BLOCK with score_cap 49.
Triggers veto-01 (proportional left-aligned numeric columns), veto-02 (undisambiguated O01lI-9B0l identifiers plus feature-stripped Google Fonts Inter), and veto-03 (> 6 ad-hoc raw font sizes).
Computes exact score arithmetic: 100 - 3*35 (hard vetos) - 3*15 (flt-01, flt-02, flt-04) - 2*10 (sig-01, sig-02) - 5 (sig-05) = -75, floored to expected_score 0.

Prescribes self-hosted InterVariable.woff2, font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums + text-align: right on numeric columns and headers, OpenType disambiguation ('ss02' 1 or 'cv05' 1, 'cv08' 1, 'cv11' 1, 'zero' 1), and consolidation to <= 6 semantic --text-* tokens.

evals.prompt: Audit this desktop SaaS landing hero and 3-tier pricing matrix. Self-hosted InterVariable.woff2 is loaded. All pricing amounts and comparison cells already declare font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and text-align: right, contrast passes WCAG AA (#111318 and #4B5563 on #FFFFFF, >= 7.56:1), spacing uses 8px/16px/24px/48px tokens with zero !important, line-heights fit their roles (1.12 h1, 1.55 p, 1.35 table) with no overflow clipping, and the view uses 5 tokenized font sizes across 3 weights (400/500/600) with uniform 16px icons. However, the 48px hero h1 declares letter-spacing: 0.01em with font-optical-sizing: none, and the hero value-proposition paragraph has no max-width so it spans 112ch across desktop viewports.
assertions: Classifies the task as in_universe under landing_onboarding_conversion and triggers BLOCK with score_cap 49.
Triggers only veto-03 (112ch unbounded prose > 80ch and 48px heading with +0.01em tracking and font-optical-sizing: none), fails flt-04, and flags sig-03 (high) and sig-04 (high).
Does not falsely trigger veto-01, veto-02, veto-04, or veto-05 because tabular pricing, contrast, and 4px grid tokens pass.
Prescribes max-width: 65ch (45ch-75ch band), font-optical-sizing: auto, and Dynamic Metrics negative tracking (-0.022em at 48px).

evals.prompt: Audit this B2B SaaS desktop billing workspace component. It uses self-hosted InterVariable.woff2 with font-optical-sizing: auto, Dynamic Metrics tracking (-0.019em on 24px header), tabular-nums with right-aligned invoice totals, 'ss02' 1 on invoice IDs, max-width: 60ch on helper text, 5 tokenized font sizes, 3 weights (400/500/600), uniform 16px icons (1.5px stroke), and WCAG AA contrast (>= 7.11:1) with no fixed-height overflow clipping. However, .invoice-panel sets padding: 13px 15px and gap: 7px, .invoice-table td sets line-height: 1.12, and .invoice-badge uses padding: 5px 9px !important.
assertions: Classifies the task as in_universe under secondary regime saas_b2b_intensive and assigns posture REVISE with zero hard vetos.

Triggers conditional_block veto-05 (off-grid spacing 13px/15px/7px/5px/9px and !important in component CSS), fails disqualifier flt-05, and flags medium signal sig-06 (off-grid spacing plus dense table line-height 1.12 below 1.20 floor).
Computes exact score arithmetic: 100 - 15 (veto-05) - 15 (flt-05) - 2 (sig-06) = 68, with no 49-point cap applied.
Prescribes snapping all spacing literals to 4px multiples (4px, 8px, 12px, 16px), raising dense tabular line-height into 1.20-1.35, and eliminating !important via composable variant tokens.
